messages:
maya: FYI — acme-corp cannot apply promo code 'STARTUP100' for a free trial. API returns `blocked_by_risk`. Customer insists they're legitimate; says they're traveling and using corporate VPN. Can we do manual review and possibly grant a provisional trial?

maya: Error snippet from apply endpoint: 
```
promo_apply error: blocked_by_risk
risk_score=0.86
reasons=[vpn_detected, disposable_email, card_bin_mismatch]
request_id=req_01GZ8X0Z9Y
```

sarah-cs: Adding context from convo with the customer: account created 2026-03-14 09:12 UTC, billing card is a company card (ACME LTD), card BIN resolves to GB, but current IP geolocates to NL and our VPN detector flagged it. Customer says they use corporate VPN while traveling Europe. Email used on sign-up was an alias (name@acme.mailinator.com) — they have a real corporate address.

alex: Can you paste the full risk payload and headers (user-agent, x-forwarded-for) so I can check device history? If it's just VPN + alias email, manual override after identity verification is usually fine. If we see multiple payment instruments or chargeback history, escalate.

maya: Pasting redacted risk payload: 
```
{"risk_score":0.86, "flags":["vpn_detected","disposable_email"], "payment_history": {"card_count": 1, "recent_failures": 0}, "geoip_country":"NL"}
```

jamie: Heads up — we pushed an updated geoip DB yesterday and we've seen a small spike in false positives for VPN detection (proxy IP ranges misclassified). Our classifier's blocking threshold is risk_score > 0.8, so 0.86 tripped. I'll re-run geoip + re-score.

alex: I'll also pull the device history and check for linked accounts. If it's clean and customer can prove corporate email + a photo ID, I can grant a provisional 7-day trial and mark ticket for longer review. Tagging the bot to create a manual_review ticket. :eyes:

incident-bot: Created manual_review ticket INF-2026-4873 and assigned to alex. Secure intake link: https://redwood-internal/reviews/INF-2026-4873

sarah-cs: Customer is willing to provide a corporate email and a photo ID selfie. They want to avoid delays — can we do a short provisional grant while they upload docs?

alex: I can issue a provisional 7-day trial grant contingent on secure upload of: 1) corporate email verification (send link to that address), 2) selfie ID upload to secure intake. Sending secure upload link via support DM now.

maya: Sent secure intake link to the customer and requested the corp email verification. Also left a note in CRM: INF-2026-4873. Jamie — can you prioritize the geoip re-run and re-score for this request?

jamie: Re-running geoip DB and classifier re-score now. If the VPN tag was a false positive we'll get the score down. Will ping once done. :lock:

alex: Update: re-score complete after geoip correction -> risk_score 0.42; disposable alias confirmed (user had an alias but provided real corp email), customer uploaded selfie ID and email was verified. I've granted the provisional 7-day trial and escalated to full review for onboarding. Closing manual ticket with note.

maya: Thanks all — sent the customer confirmation and next steps. Marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
